defects.description: Code token `subject-reference` was translated to `Объект обсуждения-reference`, breaking the requirement for byte‑identical code tokens.
Code token `subject_id` was translated to `Объект обсуждения_id`, violating the byte‑identical code token rule.
Code token `severity` (both the key and the type) was replaced with `Уровень серьёзности`, which must remain unchanged.
